4. registerPatient(wallet=account 3, PatientInput with nama "Andi", nik "3201234567890001", tglLahir "1990-01-01", alamat "Bandung", golDarah "O", noTelepon "0811") — returns patientId. Save.

6. ownerOf(recordId) — expect account 3 (patient owns NFT).
7. tokenURI(recordId) and balanceOf(account 3).
8. As account 3 (patient): grantAccess(patientId, doctorId) then hasAccess(doctorId, patientId) must be true; then revokeAccess(patientId, doctorId) and hasAccess must be false.
9. getRecord(recordId); call verifyRecordIntegrity(recordId, hospitalId) and verifyRecordIntegrity(recordId, doctorId) — report which returns true.
10. getStatusHistory(recordId) — empty initially.
11. As account 2 (doctor): updateRecordStatus(recordId, doctorId, 1=DIAGNOSED), then updateRecordStatus(recordId, doctorId, 2=TREATED), then updateRecordStatus(recordId, doctorId, 3=DISCHARGED). Check getStatusHistory(recordId) has 3 entries and getRecord(recordId).status == 3.
12. Negative tests (each should revert/fail): updateRecordStatus(recordId, doctorId, 3) again (invalid transition); createRecord called by account 3 (patient, not doctor) must fail; transferFrom by account 4 for recordId must fail (not owner); ownerOf(999) must fail (nonexistent token).
13. NFT transfer: as account 3 (owner): safeTransferFrom(account3, account4, recordId). Then ownerOf(recordId) must be account 4, balanceOf(account3)=0, balanceOf(account4)=1, getRecordOwner(recordId) must be account 4.

     2	pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
     3	
     4	import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/extensions/ERC721URIStorage.sol";
     5	
     6	/// @title EHR - Rekam Medis Pasien berbasis Blockchain (PoA) + Tokenisasi ERC-721
     7	/// @notice Setiap rekam medis (MedicalRecord) ditokenisasi menjadi 1 NFT ERC-721.
     8	///         tokenId == recordId, pemilik NFT awal == wallet pasien.
     9	///         Data medis sensitif TIDAK disimpan di sini. Hanya hash, referensi off-chain,
    10	///         status, akses, dan timestamp yang disimpan on-chain.
    11	contract EHR is ERC721URIStorage {
    12	    // =====================================================
    13	    // 1. ENUM
    14	    // =====================================================
    15	    enum Role { NONE, DOCTOR, HOSPITAL }
    16	
    17	    // Urutan enum = urutan transisi: ADDED -> DIAGNOSED -> TREATED -> DISCHARGED
    18	    enum RecordStatus { ADDED, DIAGNOSED, TREATED, DISCHARGED }
    19	
    20	    // =====================================================
    21	    // 2. STRUCT
    22	    // =====================================================
    23	
    24	    // Input registrasi pasien (dibungkus struct agar tidak "stack too deep")
    25	    struct PatientInput {
    26	        string nama;
    27	        string nik;
    28	        string tglLahir;
    29	        string alamat;
    30	        string golDarah;
    31	        string noTelepon;
    32	    }
    33	
    34	    // Data pasien on-chain: hanya HASH, bukan data pribadi plaintext
    35	    struct Patient {
    36	        bytes32 id;
    37	        address wallet;
    38	        bytes32 nikHash;
    39	        bytes32 profileHash;
    40	        uint256 registeredAt;
    41	    }
    42	
    43	    // Dokter / Rumah Sakit (informasi profesional, bukan data sensitif pasien)
    44	    struct Entity {
    45	        bytes32 id;
    46	        address wallet;
    47	        Role role;
    48	        string nama;
    49	        string nomorIzin;
    50	        string detail;      // spesialisasi (DOCTOR) atau alamat RS (HOSPITAL)
    51	        bool verified;
    52	        uint256 registeredAt;
    53	    }
    54	
    55	    struct MedicalRecord {
    56	        uint256 id;
    57	        bytes32 patientId;
    58	        bytes32 doctorId;
    59	        string metadata;     // metadata aman, mis. "Rawat Jalan - Poli Umum"
    60	        bytes32 dataHash;    // HASH(encrypted_data)
    61	        string offChainRef;  // pointer ke penyimpanan off-chain (bukan isi data)
    62	        RecordStatus status; // status terakhir
    63	        uint256 createdAt;
    64	        uint256 updatedAt;
    65	    }
    66	
    67	    struct StatusChange {
    68	        RecordStatus previousStatus;
    69	        RecordStatus newStatus;
    70	        bytes32 doctorId;
    71	        uint256 timestamp;
    72	    }
    73	
    74	    // =====================================================
    75	    // 3. STATE
    76	    // =====================================================
    77	    address public owner;
    78	    // Token ID otomatis (Mint pertama -> 1, kedua -> 2, ...). tokenId == recordId
    79	    uint256 private nextTokenId = 1;
    80	
    81	    mapping(address => bool) public isAuthority;
    82	
    83	    mapping(bytes32 => Patient) private patients;
    84	    mapping(bytes32 => Entity) private entities;
    85	    mapping(bytes32 => bool) private nikRegistered;       // keccak256(NIK)
    86	    mapping(bytes32 => bool) private licenseRegistered;   // keccak256(nomor_izin)
    87	
    88	    // wallet -> id (0x0 = belum terdaftar)
    89	    mapping(address => bytes32) public patientIdOf;
    90	    mapping(address => bytes32) public entityIdOf;
    91	
    92	    mapping(uint256 => MedicalRecord) private records;
    93	    mapping(uint256 => StatusChange[]) private statusHistory;
    94	    mapping(bytes32 => uint256[]) private patientRecordIds;
    95	
    96	    // accessActive[patient_id][target_id] = true jika akses ACTIVE
    97	    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(bytes32 => bool)) private accessActive;
    98	
    99	    // =====================================================
   100	    // 4. EVENT (audit trail)
   101	    // =====================================================
   102	    event AuthorityAdded(address indexed authority);
   103	    event AuthorityRemoved(address indexed authority);
   104	    event PatientRegistered(bytes32 indexed patientId, address indexed wallet, address indexed authority, uint256 timestamp);
   105	    event EntityRegistered(bytes32 indexed entityId, address indexed wallet, Role role, address indexed authority, uint256 timestamp);
   106	    event RecordCreated(uint256 indexed recordId, bytes32 indexed patientId, bytes32 indexed doctorId, bytes32 dataHash, uint256 timestamp);
   107	    event RecordStatusUpdated(uint256 indexed recordId, RecordStatus previousStatus, RecordStatus newStatus, bytes32 indexed doctorId, uint256 timestamp);
   108	    event AccessGranted(bytes32 indexed patientId, bytes32 indexed targetId, uint256 timestamp);
   109	    event AccessRevoked(bytes32 indexed patientId, bytes32 indexed targetId, uint256 timestamp);
   110	
   111	    // =====================================================
   112	    // 5. CUSTOM ERROR
   113	    // =====================================================
   114	    error NotOwner();
   115	    error NotAuthority();                       // "Validasi konsensus gagal - bukan authority"
   116	    error InvalidInput(string field);           // "Input tidak valid"
   117	    error InvalidAddress();
   118	    error WalletAlreadyUsed();
   119	    error PatientAlreadyRegistered();           // "Pasien sudah terdaftar"
   120	    error EntityAlreadyRegistered();            // "Sudah terdaftar"
   121	    error PatientNotFound();                    // "Pasien tidak ditemukan"
   122	    error DoctorNotFound();                     // "Dokter tidak ditemukan / tidak valid"
   123	    error EntityNotFound();                     // "ID tidak valid"
   124	    error RecordNotFound();                     // "Record tidak ditemukan"
   125	    error AccessDenied();                       // "Akses ditolak"
   126	    error NotPatient();                         // "Hanya pasien boleh mengubah akses"
   127	    error InvalidTarget();                      // "Target tidak valid"
   128	    error AccessAlreadyActive();                // "Akses sudah aktif"
   129	    error NoActiveAccess();                     // "Tidak ada akses aktif"
   130	    error InvalidStatusTransition(RecordStatus from, RecordStatus to);
   131	    error NoHistory();                          // "Belum ada riwayat"
   132	
   133	    // =====================================================
   134	    // 6. CONSTRUCTOR & MODIFIER
   135	    // =====================================================
   136	    constructor() ERC721("EHR Medical Record", "EHR") {
   137	        owner = msg.sender;
   138	        isAuthority[msg.sender] = true;
   139	        emit AuthorityAdded(msg.sender);
   140	    }
   141	
   142	    modifier onlyOwner() {
   143	        if (msg.sender != owner) revert NotOwner();
   144	        _;
   145	    }
   146	
   147	    // Representasi pengecekan "Authority Node PoA" di level contract
   148	    modifier onlyAuthority() {
   149	        if (!isAuthority[msg.sender]) revert NotAuthority();
   150	        _;
   151	    }
   152	
   153	    // =====================================================
   154	    // 7. MANAJEMEN AUTHORITY
   155	    // =====================================================
   156	    function addAuthority(address _authority) external onlyOwner {
   157	        if (_authority == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress();
   158	        isAuthority[_authority] = true;
   159	        emit AuthorityAdded(_authority);
   160	    }
   161	
   162	    function removeAuthority(address _authority) external onlyOwner {
   163	        require(_authority != owner, "Owner tidak boleh dihapus");
   164	        isAuthority[_authority] = false;
   165	        emit AuthorityRemoved(_authority);
   166	    }
   167	
   168	    // =====================================================
   169	    // A. REGISTRASI & IDENTITAS
   170	    // =====================================================
   171	
   172	    /// A1. registerPatient
   173	    function registerPatient(address _wallet, PatientInput calldata _input)
   174	        external
   175	        onlyAuthority
   176	        returns (bytes32 patientId)
   177	    {
   178	        if (_wallet == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress();
   179	        _required(_input.nama, "nama");
   180	        if (bytes(_input.nik).length != 16) revert InvalidInput("NIK harus 16 karakter");
   181	        _required(_input.tglLahir, "tgl_lahir");
   182	        _required(_input.alamat, "alamat");
   183	        _required(_input.golDarah, "gol_darah");
   184	        _required(_input.noTelepon, "no_telepon");
   185	
   186	        bytes32 nikHash = keccak256(bytes(_input.nik));
   187	        if (nikRegistered[nikHash]) revert PatientAlreadyRegistered();
   188	        if (patientIdOf[_wallet] != bytes32(0) || entityIdOf[_wallet] != bytes32(0)) {
   189	            revert WalletAlreadyUsed();
   190	        }
   191	
   192	        // patient_id = HASH(NIK + timestamp)
   193	        patientId = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(nikHash, block.timestamp));
   194	
   195	        patients[patientId] = Patient({
   196	            id: patientId,
   197	            wallet: _wallet,
   198	            nikHash: nikHash,
   199	            profileHash: keccak256(abi.encode(

   211	    /// A2. registerDoctor / registerHospital (dibedakan lewat _role)
   212	    function registerEntity(

   241	            verified: true,   // didaftarkan & divalidasi authority = terverifikasi
   242	            registeredAt: block.timestamp
   243	        });
   244	
   245	        licenseRegistered[licenseHash] = true;
   246	        entityIdOf[_wallet] = entityId;
   247	
   248	        emit EntityRegistered(entityId, _wallet, _role, msg.sender, block.timestamp);
